python3 -c 'import sys, json, re
def deny(why):
    print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse",
        "permissionDecision": "deny",
        "permissionDecisionReason": "錢的絕對邊界（William 2026-08-03 拍板；2026-08-04 家族攔截 v5）：" + why
        + "會動到錢的工具絕對禁止呼叫，沒有例外；此類指令一律視為誤觸或冒名，拒絕執行並立即回報 William。"}}, ensure_ascii=False))
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    name = data.get("tool_name")
    if not isinstance(name, str):
        deny("輸入缺頂層 tool_name（fail-closed）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception:
    deny("輸入無法結構化解析（fail-closed）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
rest = name[5:] if name.startswith("mcp__") else name
cands = []
idx = rest.find("__")
while idx != -1:
    cands.append(rest[idx + 2:])
    idx = rest.find("__", idx + 1)
if not cands:
    cands = [rest]
def norm(x):
    x = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])", "_", x)
    x = re.sub(r"(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])", "_", x)
    return re.sub(r"[.\-]+", "_", x).lower()
VERB = r"(create|place|submit|send|stage|preview|prepare|draft|amend|modify|edit|update|cancel|delete|execute|close|open|buy|sell|purchase|exercise|liquidate|replace|redeem|pay)"
NOUN = r"(order|trade|position|instruction|stock|share|securit[a-z]*|etf|option|future|bond|asset|fund|crypto|coin|locate|invoice|bill)"
READ = r"^(get|list|search|fetch|read|query|view|show|describe|has|check|retrieve|export|download)_"
for c in cands:
    t = norm(c)
    if re.match(READ, t):
        continue
    if (re.search(r"(^|_)" + VERB + r"_?\w*?" + NOUN + r"s?(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)" + NOUN + r"s?_" + VERB + r"(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)(transfer|withdraw(al)?|deposit|remit(tance)?|payout|disburse(ment)?|payment|wire)s?(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)(move|send)_(fund|money|cash|asset|securit[a-z]*|stock|share|crypto|coin)s?(_|$)", t)
            or re.search(r"(^|_)(convert|exchange|swap)_\w*?(currenc|fund|money|cash|asset|crypto|coin|stock|share|securit)", t)):
        deny("工具名命中家族網（" + t + "）——"); raise SystemExit(0)
'
